public function parse_command(arguments: List of Text) returns Command
  purpose: Turn command-line words into a command; anything unrecognized is Help.
  example: parse_command(["add", "buy", "milk"]) is Add(task: "buy milk")
  example: parse_command(["done", "2"]) is Done(position: 2)
  example: parse_command([]) is Help

  let verb be arguments.first() otherwise return Help
  let words be arguments.rest()
  if verb is "add" then
    if words.is_empty() then
      return Help
    end
    return Add(task: words.join(" "))
  otherwise if verb is "done" then
    if words.length() is not 1 then
      return Help
    end
    let word be words.first() otherwise return Help
    let number be word.to_integer() otherwise return Help
    return Done(position: number) otherwise return Help
  otherwise if verb is "show" then
    return Show
  otherwise
    return Help
  end
end
